exception.change_from_previous_archive: Only ref-names changed from HEAD -> main to an empty value (the trailing space and LF remain).
exception.validation: The complete expanded file matches the commit's template substitutions. Replacing only that expanded blob with its authenticated template reconstructs the exact root tree.

method: Recomputed the pinned commit object's Git hash; hashed every archive blob and mode and compared the complete path inventory with git ls-tree. Deterministic gzip recompression reproduced both the previous archive checksum as a control and the new checksum after the single export-subst metadata change. An independent full recheck passed.
limits: The new complete archive was reconstructed from the previous intact archive, not freshly downloaded in full. Its SHA-256 exactly matches the new downloads reported by GitHub Actions. The raw expanded archive tree is not byte-identical to the raw Git tree; the single explicitly verified export-subst exception is described above. No checksum or extraction checks were disabled.
